question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Shape'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most **appropriate option** to fill in blank number 3 is** "shape."**
 
• **Swelling** in the joints **may cause **affected joints to increase in size or appear to be an** odd shape.**
 
• When** joints become **swollen, the accumulation of fluid can lead to visible changes in the joint's size and contour.
 
• This **can result in** joints appearing **larger or taking on an irregular shape** compared to their normal appearance.

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *In some cases, swelling may cause affected joints to increase in size or appear to be an odd **shape** Joint pain and swelling can affect more than one **joint** at a time*.
